title: KillMe To kill youself
body:
KillMe To Kill youself!
A lightweight and simple utility plugin for Paper and Spigot servers that allows players to quickly reset by ending their life via command.

Features
- Instant Action: No delays, no countdowns—just run the command and respawn.

- Lightweight: Minimal impact on server performance.

- Easy to Use: Perfect for players who get stuck or want a quick way back to their spawn point.

Commands
- /killme: Kills the player who executes the command.

Installation
1. Download the KillMe.jar file.

2. Place it into your server's plugins folder.

3. Restart or reload your server.


Compatibility
Designed for Paper and Spigot.

Compatible with Minecraft versions 1.20 and above.

Developed for simple server management and player utility.
